analyst.summary: RVNL has a very large, multi-year railway and telecom-infrastructure order book (about Rs 99,000 crore, roughly 5x last year's revenue) and sits at the center of India's rail-capex programme, but recent profitability has weakened sharply -- FY26 net profit fell about a third even as revenue was flat, operating margin fell as low as ~1.4% in the latest quarter, and payments from its main government client have slowed markedly (collection days have nearly quadrupled over the year). The stock still trades at a rich ~55x earnings multiple despite this. We see the order-book story as genuine but not yet delivering the returns the valuation assumes, and recommend Sell on a hold-review basis until margin recovery and collections actually show up in the numbers.
